turns.question: For outreach messages sent between 20 September and 3 October 2026 that got a reply, what was the 75th percentile of hours between the message and the reply?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the time between an outreach message and its reply, so it cannot give a 75th percentile (or any percentile) of reply hours for messages sent 20 September to 3 October 2026; the closest metrics are Messages replied (messages_replied), Replies (replies), Messages sent (messages_sent) and Reply rate (reply_rate).
